title: Middle-click to open with secondary associated application on the desktop
line: Middle-clicking a file on the desktop now opens it with its second associated app (Shift for the third), like in Dolphin.
explanation: Folder View didn't accept the middle button on the desktop at all, so middle-clicking a file did nothing, while Dolphin opens it with the second application associated with its type (Shift for the third). The change adds FolderModel::runWithAlternativeApplication(), which mirrors Dolphin's logic through KApplicationTrader and ApplicationLauncherJob (folders, or files without a second app, open normally), and makes FolderView accept a middle press only over an item and open it on release without touching the selection. Middle-clicks on empty space are left unaccepted, so containment mouse actions bound to the middle button keep working.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: open files with the second app on middle-click

Middle-clicking a file on the desktop did nothing, while Dolphin opens it
with the second application associated with its type. Do the same in
Folder View, with Shift for the third one, like Dolphin does.

BUG: 507880

media.caption: Master: notes.txt (Kate first, Mousepad second) middle-clicked on the desktop; nothing opens.
With the fix: the same middle-click opens notes.txt in Mousepad, its second associated app.
